meta.description: Voie actions (lookup) — 80 questions curées main, 13 familles, vérité=comptage exact re-calculable. Couvre toutes les dimensions ActionSpec + ensemble/fausse-prémisse/booléen/culture-juste/edge.

questions.question: Combien d'actions correctives ?
questions.cypher_reference: MATCH (i0:IncidentSecu)-[r:A_POUR_ACTION]->(a:Action) WHERE coalesce(i0.is_test_data,false)=false AND r.type_action='corrective' RETURN count(DISTINCT a) AS n

questions.cypher_reference: MATCH (i0:IncidentSecu)-[r:A_POUR_ACTION]->(a:Action) WHERE coalesce(i0.is_test_data,false)=false AND r.type_action='corrective' AND substring(a.date_prevue,0,4)='2025' RETURN count(DISTINCT a) AS n

questions.question: Combien d'actions pour les incidents de collision aviaire ?
questions.cypher_reference: MATCH (i0:IncidentSecu)-[r:A_POUR_ACTION]->(a:Action) WHERE coalesce(i0.is_test_data,false)=false AND toLower(i0.titre) CONTAINS 'aviaire' RETURN count(DISTINCT a) AS n

questions.question: Combien d'actions préventives ont été créées en 2024 ?
questions.cypher_reference: MATCH (i0:IncidentSecu)-[r:A_POUR_ACTION]->(a:Action) WHERE coalesce(i0.is_test_data,false)=false AND r.type_action='préventive' AND substring(a.date_ajout,0,4)='2024' RETURN count(DISTINCT a) AS n

questions.question: Combien d'actions ont été clôturées pour les incidents intolérables ?
questions.cypher_reference: MATCH (i0:IncidentSecu)-[r:A_POUR_ACTION]->(a:Action) WHERE coalesce(i0.is_test_data,false)=false AND i0.severite='5 - intolérable' AND (a.statut = '100' OR a.date_cloture IS NOT NULL) RETURN count(DISTINCT a) AS n

questions.question: Y a-t-il des actions correctives sans échéance définie ?
questions.cypher_reference: MATCH (i0:IncidentSecu)-[r:A_POUR_ACTION]->(a:Action) WHERE coalesce(i0.is_test_data,false)=false AND r.type_action='corrective' AND a.date_prevue IS NULL RETURN count(DISTINCT a) AS n
